findings.evidence: PART-11 already owns EligibilityDecision.directive and its final detailed cause, while BEH-02 gives PART-13 only request, fault, recovery, and that decision to copy into CTRL-02. Copying/bundling makes PART-13 an identity wrapper; independently reselecting the same cause would duplicate PART-11's decision boundary.

Credit PART-13 only for combining generic EQUIPMENT with PART-08.primaryCause and mapping the other generic reasons to the unchanged detailed CTRL-02 limitingCause; keep copied status fields uncredited. Retain PART-11/13, INT-27/29, all counts, CTRL types, policies, scenarios, and claim exclusions.

findings.evidence: PART-12 claims one-shot release ownership for the current pending request and BEH-01 calls for decision/request enumeration, but its sole planned input is INT-27 EligibilityDecision. Without request phase it cannot distinguish pending, completed, or rearmed requests; relying entirely on PART-11's pending check reduces its observable mapping to decision forwarding plus state with no request-local reset basis.
findings.requested_change: Reroute INT-35 from PART-08->PART-11 to PART-07->PART-12 carrying published request phase. PART-11 derives generic EQUIPMENT from its existing six assessments and leaves detailed primary cause in PART-08/PART-13. Make PART-12 combine request phase, decision, and prior ledger state for one-shot release and request-based rearm. Keep exactly 35 INTs and unchanged CTRL behavior.

findings.evidence: OWN-01 credits PART-08 with state ownership, but CASE-23/24 use only the six current assessment inputs; no prior Fault Registry value affects its output. Conversely, PART-08's 15,360-input current relation is a substantive seven-result priority classification.
findings.requested_change: Remove only PART-08's state-owner claim in OWN-01/AUD-03 and retain it as the sole current FaultSummary decision owner. PART-07, PART-10, and repaired PART-12 continue to satisfy multiple-state-owner behavior; no PART, INT, case, metric, or domain rule changes.

findings.evidence: The PART-07->PART-09->PART-07 and PART-07->PART-11->PART-12->PART-07 current-value paths are realizable without an algebraic cycle if PART-07 publishes In(requestState) and commits its next state locally. This matches SCN-01's PENDING/PERMIT snapshot followed by RELEASED feedback. CASE-13..17 never use the request-phase field currently bundled on INT-20.
findings.requested_change: Define INT-20/26/32/revised-35 request phase as the published pre-evaluation value, keep INT-28 feedback as an update input, and remove unused request phase from INT-20 while retaining its candidate-event flow and connection count. Preserve every CASE-18..22 transition and scenario outcome.
